title: Minification
body:
Mechanically shrinking shipped code without changing behaviour: stripping whitespace and comments, shortening local variable and function names to single letters, collapsing expressions. A build-time step, run by the [[Module Bundler]], producing a file that's dramatically smaller to transfer and parse.

It's a transfer-size optimisation, not a security measure — minified code is trivially readable once formatted, so no secret is ever safe in a frontend bundle. Because names get mangled, minified stack traces are unreadable without [[Source Maps]], and code that relies on `Function.prototype.name` or on class names surviving can break. Distinct from [[Tree Shaking]], which removes whole unused modules rather than compressing what remains.
